case_goal: Verify that a user can successfully log in to phpMyAdmin using valid credentials (admin/admin) and that the user info element is displayed after login. The process is performed twice to ensure repeatability.
summary: Navigate to phpMyAdmin login page, clear and enter username 'admin', clear and enter password 'admin', click login button, verify that the user info element (li_user_info) is present on the resulting page. Then repeat the entire process a second time.

steps.expected_result: Login page loaded with username, password fields and submit button
Username field cleared and populated with 'admin'
Password field cleared and populated with 'admin'
Login form submitted, page navigates to index.php with title containing 'phpmyadmin-db-old'
Element with id 'li_user_info' is present, indicating successful login
Login page loaded again (possibly after logout or navigation)
Username field cleared and populated with 'admin'
Password field cleared and populated with 'admin'
Element with id 'li_user_info' is present, confirming second login
